summary: Iteration 4 of Merizo (7 bug fixes + 3 improvements + 8 AI features). Backend: 10/10 new pytest pass (test_iteration4.py) + earlier 38/38 still green = 48/48 total. Verified live Gemini-2.5-flash calls for /api/trips/{id}/ai/overview returning place_facts (Goa Trip: place + >=2 facts) and personality (College Buddies: title/emoji/description); cached on second call (place_facts identical). Verified POST /api/expenses/parse-upi returns {amount:350.0, merchant:'Swiggy', category:'food', currency:'INR'} for the canonical SMS, 400 for empty/short text. Verified PATCH /api/trips/{id}/currency converts amount_base + budget by FX (INR->USD shrinks by ~83x; round-trip back to INR within 5%). Verified DELETE /api/trips/{id} now allows non-owner members (fresh user joined via invite then deleted -> 200), still 403 for non-members. Verified GET /api/smart-limit payload now includes ai_source ('ai_cache' on demo user, weekly_budget=6113.0 != statistical fallback 5830) and cache='hit' on repeat. Frontend smoke: login -> home -> profile flow, demo login works, Profile shows horizontal-scroll stats (SPLITS / TOTAL SPENT / ACTIVE — 3rd card visible past the scroll), DotNum dot-matrix numbers render BOTH the YOU ARE OWED ₹1,400 on Home AND the SPLITS/TOTAL SPENT on Profile in LIGHT mode (black dots on off-white). Overbudget toggle present (testID=overbudget-toggle), Sign out button visible.

critical.issue: Spec says response should include recurring_suggestion when adding a duplicate-name expense whose previous one is >25 days old, but the recurring_suggestion code is currently placed inside the SETTLE endpoint (server.py lines 496-538), NOT inside add_expense. Worse, the block accesses req.category and req.name which DO NOT exist on SettleReq (only from_member/to_member/amount). For a home-category trip, calling /settle would throw AttributeError -> 500 since the `if (split_category=='home' and req.category=='home')` line is reached. The block must be moved to add_expense and use req.name / req.category from ExpenseCreateReq.

parse_upi() (server.py:1193): returns 400 only when text < 6 chars; if Gemini returns garbage it 422s. Could also strict-validate that amount > 0 to surface 422 for the {'amount':0,'merchant':''} fallback object. Currently a malformed message could return amount=0 with status 200 — main agent may want a validation pass.

delete_trip() (server.py:383): membership check now uses owner_id OR any member.user_id — correctly allows joined users (not just trip-creator) to delete. Verified.

smart_limit (server.py:807) + compute_smart_limit_for_user (647): ai_source field present in payload ('ai_fresh' | 'ai_cache' | 'statistical'). Live demo run returned ai_source='ai_cache' weekly_budget=6113.0 (≠ statistical fallback 5830) — confirming Gemini round-trip + cache hit.

rca_of_issue: BUG (recurring_suggestion in wrong endpoint): /app/backend/server.py settle() at lines 496-538 contains the recurring detector. SettleReq has only {from_member, to_member, amount} so `req.category` and `req.name` accesses on lines 499 and 501 raise AttributeError. Because the outer guard `if (trip.split_category=='home') and req.category=='home'` short-circuits on the AttributeError, the request would fail with HTTP 500 for ANY home-category settle. Even worse, the spec wanted this on add_expense, not settle, so add_expense never returns recurring_suggestion at all. Mitigation: cut lines 496-538 from settle(), paste them inside add_expense() right before `return serialize_trip(trip, user['id'])`, change `req.category` -> `req.category` (already correct on ExpenseCreateReq), keep `req.name` -> req.name, and re-check that target = req.name.strip().lower() and the new expense.id is excluded from the prev loop.
